Incident Workflow

A structured sequence of tasks and escalation steps followed during the lifecycle of a security incident, from detection through resolution and post-incident review.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Incident Workflow?

In this glossary, Incident Workflow refers to: A structured sequence of tasks and escalation steps followed during the lifecycle of a security incident, from detection through resolution and post-incident review.

How is Incident Workflow used in cybersecurity?

In cybersecurity communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "The SOC followed the established incident workflow to ensure all notification and escalation steps were properly executed."

Why does Incident Workflow matter in cybersecurity?

Incident Workflow matters because it supports clear communication in SOC contexts for SOC Analysts, Security Engineers, and Incident Responders. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as CISSP, CompTIA Security+, and CEH.

Who uses Incident Workflow?

Incident Workflow is mainly used by SOC Analysts, Security Engineers, and Incident Responders.

What category does Incident Workflow belong to?
